36d752fb: What are the names of the three protagonists of GTA V?
Michael De Santa, Trevor Philips and Franklin Clinton are the three playable protagonists of GTA V, each with a radically different personality and past.
5a8f1412: In which fictional city is GTA V set?
Los Santos is GTA V's fictional city, based on Los Angeles, with Vinewood (Hollywood), the beaches of Del Perro (Santa Monica) and the upscale hills of Rockford Hills (Beverly Hills).
2ea8b7fa: What is the final heist of GTA V's story?
The Union Depository heist is the grand finale: Michael, Trevor and Franklin go after Los Santos's gold reserve, with either a subtle or an obvious approach.
027cee50: Which protagonist, a former bank robber, lives in retirement under a false identity?
Michael De Santa lives under a false identity with his family in Rockford Hills, thanks to a deal with the FIB. Meeting Franklin pulls him back into crime.
d0b0b012: What is the name of the fictional state where Los Santos is located?
San Andreas is GTA V's fictional state, based on Southern California, with Los Santos (LA), Blaine County (rural valleys) and the desert around Sandy Shores.
cac3974b: What does FIB stand for in the GTA universe?
The FIB (Federal Investigation Bureau) is the GTA universe's version of the FBI. Trevor, Michael and Franklin deal with its agents, especially Steve Haines, who manipulates them.
23d3ed4a: What is GTA V's multiplayer mode called?
GTA Online is GTA V's massive multiplayer mode. Launched in 2013, it keeps getting new missions, vehicles, properties and activities for up to 30 players per session.
17f08a1e: What are the famous hills of Los Santos inspired by the Hollywood Sign called?
The Vinewood Hills are home to the famous Vinewood Sign, inspired by the Hollywood Sign, an icon of Los Santos visible from all over the city.
3a1f2617: What is the tallest building in Los Santos?
The Maze Bank Tower is Los Santos's tallest skyscraper, inspired by the U.S. Bank Tower in Los Angeles. In GTA Online, players can buy it as an office.
14a14755: Which GTA V ending lets every protagonist survive?
Option C (Deathwish) is the ending where everyone survives: Michael, Trevor and Franklin team up to take out their common enemies instead of betraying each other.
b1c2be15: What is the name of the Blaine County prison in GTA V?
Bolingbroke Penitentiary is Blaine County's large prison. In GTA Online, the Prison Break heist involves breaking an inmate out of it.
327e2127: Which taxi company can the player call in GTA V?
Downtown Cab Co. is Los Santos's taxi company. Franklin can even buy it, and the player can call a cab from their phone.
c5e30790: Which GTA Online property lets you run businesses behind a legitimate front?
The Nightclub lets you run legal and illegal businesses under cover, passively collecting goods from the player's other businesses.
07c6c24a: Which high-end clothing store in GTA V is inspired by the boutiques of Rodeo Drive?
Ponsonbys is GTA V's luxury clothing store, where you can dress the characters in chic outfits. It is inspired by the boutiques of Rodeo Drive in Beverly Hills.
447dc051: Which iconic vehicle in GTA V is a jet that can take off vertically?
The Hydra is a vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) jet inspired by the Harrier Jump Jet. It can hover to take off and land, then switch to fast jet mode.
84ce52d5: Which corrupt FIB agent blackmails the protagonists of GTA V?
Steve Haines is the FIB agent who manipulates Michael, Trevor and Franklin for his own ends, forcing them into risky jobs.
72e69215: What is the name of the GTA V radio station that plays West Coast hip-hop?
West Coast Classics is GTA V's hip-hop station, playing classics from artists such as 2Pac, Snoop Dogg, N.W.A and Ice Cube, a perfect fit for the California setting.
30ff4ba6: What is the name of the highest mountain in San Andreas in GTA V?
Mount Chiliad is GTA V's highest mountain, reachable by cable car or off-road vehicle. Its summit hides the source of one of the game's biggest mysteries: a cryptic mural.
d952e327: Which legal pastime lets Michael relax in GTA V?
Michael is a golf enthusiast and can play at the Los Santos golf club. He also does yoga and plays tennis.
ceec09ae: What is the name of the fictional real estate site in GTA V for buying properties?
Dynasty 8 is GTA V's fictional real estate agency, accessible through the in-game phone and internet, for buying properties, garages and apartments in both story mode and GTA Online.
d66c7ded: Which actor voices Michael De Santa in GTA V?
Ned Luke provides Michael De Santa's voice and motion capture. Roger Clark plays Arthur Morgan in RDR2, Steven Ogg plays Trevor Philips and Shawn Fonteno plays Franklin Clinton.
65f541ce: What is special about the town of Paleto Bay in GTA V?
It is a small northern coastal town whose bank is robbed in the story
Paleto Bay is a small coastal town in the north of San Andreas, the site of the Paleto Score, a spectacular mission ending in a huge shootout with the army.
4f6b8209: Which GTA V fast-food chain specializes in chicken?
Cluckin' Bell is the chicken fast-food chain found all over GTA V, a parody of KFC and Taco Bell. Burger Shot (burgers), Up-n-Atom and Pizza This also appear.
68964a1e: What is the name of Los Santos's main airport?
Los Santos International Airport is inspired by Los Angeles's. It is home to the flight school where the characters can improve their skills.
55fb5d2d: What is the Rockstar Editor in GTA V?
A tool for making video clips from gameplay replays
The Rockstar Editor lets you capture, edit and share gameplay moments, with camera controls, visual effects and music. Players make elaborate machinima with it.
02451320: What is the name of the army base in GTA V?
Fort Zancudo houses fighter jets, tanks and military helicopters. Entering it immediately triggers a high wanted level.
8137c8c4: What is the name of the fictional TV news channel in GTA V?
Weazel News is GTA V's fictional news channel, a parody of Fox News. Its in-game broadcasts sometimes comment on events from the story.
a0e8eb09: What illegal business does Trevor run in the northern deserts of San Andreas?
Trevor runs an arms and drug trafficking operation out of Sandy Shores. His desert criminal business is central to his character, and he deals with bikers and cartels.
3806a0b5: Which famous GTA V supporting character helps the protagonists with his expertise?
Lester Crest is the mastermind who plans the heists. Physically disabled but a genius with computers and logistics, he is essential for recruiting the heist crews.
016310ce: How many wanted levels (stars) are there in GTA V?
The wanted level ranges from 1 to 5 stars. The more stars, the more patrols, helicopters and elite units the police send.
eb62fdd7: What happens in Option A of GTA V's ending?
In Option A, Franklin follows the FIB's demand and kills Trevor. In Option B, he kills Michael for Devin Weston. Option C, where everyone survives, is considered the canonical ending.
b31fd183: Which sports car is often cited as the fastest stock car in GTA V?
The Truffade Adder (inspired by the Bugatti Veyron) was one of the fastest stock cars at release. GTA Online has since added much faster cars, such as the Pfister 811 and other supercars.
2ca1c6ff: How does Franklin use his driving skills in the main story?
He works for a luxury car dealer doing rough repossessions
Franklin and his friend Lamar work for a luxury car dealer, Simeon Yetarian, who sends them on repossessions. It is on one of these jobs that he first meets Michael.
6be67927: Which iconic GTA Online character has guided new players since 2013?
Lamar Davis is the first character to contact the player in GTA Online. He sends missions and acts as an exuberant, comic mentor. He is also Franklin's best friend in the story.
c25eade2: Which real city is Los Santos based on in GTA V?

Los Santos is based on Los Angeles, with Vinewood (Hollywood), Rockford Hills (Beverly Hills), Davis (Compton), the industrial port (Long Beach/San Pedro) and the beaches of Del Perro (Santa Monica/Venice Beach).
95590e7c: What is the name of the character physics engine used by Rockstar in GTA V?

Euphoria is the character animation and physics engine developed by NaturalMotion. It simulates realistic reactions to impacts, falls and gunshots. RAGE is Rockstar's game engine, which integrates it.
3d70428a: How many main missions are there in GTA V's story?
GTA V's story has 69 main missions, plus many side missions and activities.
7efc1c7c: Which GTA V character is known as the most unstable and unpredictable?
Trevor Philips is the most unstable character: he can go from friendly to murderously violent in seconds. His troubled mind and chaotic lifestyle make him one of Rockstar's most memorable characters.
0fee8f99: Which criminal enterprise in GTA Online lets you manufacture illegal goods?
The Motorcycle Club businesses let you produce drugs, counterfeit cash, forged documents and more, passively while you do other things, then sell them through deliveries.
78cb5f66: What are the experience points that level you up in GTA Online called?
RP (Reputation Points) is GTA Online's experience system: it raises your rank, unlocking new vehicles, weapons, clothing and missions.
0a88d8b0: What is the name of GTA V's fictional social network parodying Facebook?
Lifeinvader is GTA V's fictional social network, a direct parody of Facebook. In one mission, Michael infiltrates its offices to rig the prototype phone the CEO unveils at his product launch.
f5baeb34: What is the first heist of the GTA V story?
The first heist targets the Vangelico jewelry store. The player chooses a smart approach, with gas and disguises, or a loud one.
f3f5ec3f: Which actor provides the voice and motion capture for Trevor Philips?
Steven Ogg gives Trevor Philips his voice, face and motion capture. He is also known for playing Simon in The Walking Dead. His performance as Trevor is widely acclaimed.
444e655b: What is Trevor's special ability in GTA V?
A rage that increases damage dealt and reduces damage taken
Trevor's ability is a red mist rage: for a few seconds, he deals more damage and takes less.
9941cebe: What was the iFruit app for GTA V used for?
iFruit: customizing cars through the real app
The real iFruit app (iOS/Android) let players customize cars at Los Santos Customs and train Chop, Franklin's dog, connected to the game.
